name: The Sith Empire returns: the Great Galactic War begins
summary: After thirteen centuries in hiding, the Sith Emperor's armada emerged from the north-east and retook Korriban in a single stroke, scattering the Jedi garrison. The Republic found itself at war with an enemy it had believed extinct.

name: The Sith conquer the Outer Rim

location.note: Sluis Van, the Minos Cluster, the Tingel Arm and the eastern Rim

summary: In its first decade the Empire overran the Tingel Arm, the Minos Cluster and dozens of Rim worlds, aiming to encircle the Republic before striking the Core. Republic fleets won isolated victories but lost the strategic picture.

name: The Sith occupy Balmorra
summary: The Empire seized the arms world Balmorra to deny the Republic its factories. A resistance fed by covert Republic support fought the occupation for decades, in open defiance of the later treaty.

name: Battle of Bothawui
summary: After a Republic fleet threw back the first Sith attack on Bothawui, a second invasion landed fifty thousand troops. Jedi Master Belth Allusis and four thousand defenders died holding a shield generator until the Sith army was spent.

name: Sith invasion of Alderaan
summary: Darth Malgus led a surprise assault on Alderaan in the heart of the Core. Republic troops under Jace Malcom and Jedi Satele Shan drove the Sith off, but the attack showed the Core was no longer safe.

name: Battle of Hoth
summary: Republic and Sith fleets fought a vast, inconclusive battle over the ice world Hoth, leaving a graveyard of wrecked capital ships on its surface that pirates and both governments later fought to salvage.

name: Mandalorian blockade of the Hydian Way

location.note: the Hydian Way between the Core and the Rim

summary: A new Mandalore, raised up by the Sith, blockaded the Hydian Way and starved the Core of Rim imports. The blockade was broken not by the Republic Navy but by a smuggler fleet under the Mirialan Hylo Visz.

name: The Sacking of Coruscant
summary: While Republic negotiators sat at a peace table on Alderaan, Darth Malgus and Darth Angral stormed the Jedi Temple and the Senate. The Temple was levelled, the Jedi Council slaughtered, and Coruscant held hostage to force the Republic's surrender.

name: Treaty of Coruscant
summary: With its capital occupied, the Republic signed a treaty ceding dozens of Rim worlds to the Empire and withdrawing from others. The Great Galactic War ended in a Sith victory on paper and a cold war in practice.

name: The Jedi withdraw to Tython
summary: Their Temple destroyed and blamed by the Senate for the war, the Jedi left Coruscant and rebuilt their Order on rediscovered Tython, the Deep Core world where it had begun.

name: The Cold War
summary: For a decade the treaty held in name while both sides fought by proxy on Balmorra, Taris, Alderaan, Hoth and Belsavis. The Sith Empire's own lords began plotting against each other and against their absent Emperor.

name: Alderaan Civil War
summary: Alderaan withdrew from the Republic in protest at the treaty, and its noble houses fell into a civil war in which House Thul fought with Sith backing and House Organa with Republic support.

name: The Republic tries to resettle Taris
summary: Three centuries after Malak's bombardment the Republic launched a reconstruction of Taris as a symbol of recovery. Sith saboteurs and rakghouls made sure it failed, and the Empire later smashed the project outright.

name: Separatist war on Ord Mantell
summary: Sith-funded separatists fought the Republic garrison for control of Ord Mantell, turning the old depot world into a guerrilla battlefield that tested whether the treaty meant anything on the ground.

name: The Galactic War resumes
summary: The Treaty of Coruscant collapsed as both sides openly resumed hostilities. Within a year the Sith Emperor's Voice was struck down on Dromund Kaas and the Republic and Empire were fighting across Corellia and Ilum.

name: The Hero of Tython strikes down the Emperor's Voice
summary: A Jedi Knight infiltrated the Emperor's citadel on Dromund Kaas and cut down the body the Emperor was using, with Lord Scourge's help. The Emperor's essence survived, but the Empire's ruling council was left to govern without him.

name: Revan is freed and defeated at the Foundry

location.note: the Maelstrom prison and the Foundry

summary: Republic agents broke Revan out of his three-century imprisonment. Bent on exterminating the Sith species with a droid army from a Rakatan Foundry, he was defeated by Imperial forces and vanished again, his mind now split.

name: Battle of Corellia
summary: The Sith seized Corellia with the help of its own corporate council, and the Republic fought a months-long campaign through the planet's cities and shipyards to take it back.

name: Battle of Ilum
summary: Both powers fought over the crystal caves of Ilum, and the renegade Darth Malgus used the chaos to declare his own empire from a stealth station in orbit before Republic and Imperial strike teams brought him down.

name: The Hutt Cartel's bid for Makeb
summary: The Hutt Cartel seized the isotope-rich world Makeb as the seed of a new Hutt empire. Republic and Imperial forces each intervened for the isotope-5 as the planet's core destabilised beneath the fighting.

name: The Revanite crisis at Yavin 4
summary: The dark half of Revan gathered an army at Rishi and Yavin 4 to resurrect the Sith Emperor and destroy him for good. A Republic–Imperial coalition stopped the ritual, but the Emperor's spirit was awakened all the same.

name: The Emperor consumes all life on Ziost
summary: Freed and hungry, the Sith Emperor possessed Ziost's population, turned it on itself and then drained every living thing on the planet as he had once drained Nathema. The Empire's old capital became a dead world.

name: Zakuul's Eternal Fleet conquers the galaxy

location.note: the Eternal Fleet struck Republic and Sith worlds alike

summary: From Wild Space the Eternal Empire of Zakuul, ruled by the Emperor in his guise as Valkorion, unleashed a droid fleet that defeated the Republic and the Sith Empire in a matter of months. Both were forced to pay tribute.

name: The Eternal Alliance is founded on Odessen
summary: The Outlander, freed from carbonite after five years, gathered Republic, Imperial and Mandalorian dissidents on the hidden world Odessen to fight Zakuul.

name: The Outlander takes the Eternal Throne
summary: The Alliance defeated the Eternal Fleet and Valkorion's heirs, and the Outlander destroyed the Sith Emperor's spirit at last. The Eternal Empire's reign over the galaxy ended after barely five years.

name: The Jedi plant a colony on Ossus
summary: With the Order scattered after Zakuul's wars, Jedi under Gnost-Dural founded a hidden colony among the ruins of Ossus. The Sith Empire found it within a year and the war between Republic and Empire flared again.
